title: Why sovereign AI is the next trillion dollar opportunity

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Sovereign AI will dominate the next decade—control the protocol, control the future. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Sovereign AI isn’t just about control—it’s about security. No centralized entity should hold that power. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Open protocols like Ethereum and Polkadot already show how decentralized AI can scale globally. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Sovereign AI ensures data remains local, reducing risks from foreign surveillance and algorithmic bias. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Sovereign AI is the only way to protect national interests in the age of AI. (4 sec)
